Package io.mavlink4j.service

Interface Command

All Known Implementing Classes:
Command.Positioned, Command.Simple
public sealed interface Command permits Command.Simple, Command.Positioned
One MAVLink command to send through CommandService.send(io.mavlink4j.PeerId, io.mavlink4j.service.Command): which MavCmd, and its parameters, named instead of positional. Two wire shapes, picked by how the command is built:
  • of(MavCmd) — a COMMAND_LONG: seven float parameters, all 0 until set.
  • positioned(io.dronefleet.mavlink.common.MavCmd, io.dronefleet.mavlink.common.MavFrame, int, int, float) — a COMMAND_INT: the spec-preferred shape for anything with a coordinate (integer lat/lon scaled by 1e7, an explicit coordinate frame).
Values are immutable; each paramN returns a modified copy.
